description: Estimate body fat percentage using the US Navy tape method from a few measurements. For males give height, neck and waist; for females give height, neck, waist and hip. Use units 'metric' (centimetres) or 'imperial' (inches). Optionally give weight (kg for metric, pounds for imperial) to also get fat mass and lean mass in kilograms. Source: https://hopi.co.uk/body-fat-calculator/

height.description: Height (cm if metric, inches if imperial)

hip.description: Hip circumference, females only (cm if metric, inches if imperial)

neck.description: Neck circumference (cm if metric, inches if imperial)

sex.description: Biological sex, determines the formula and whether hip is needed

waist.description: Waist circumference (cm if metric, inches if imperial)

weight.description: Optional weight (kg if metric, pounds if imperial) for fat and lean mass
